verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Link CLI giving a customer's own external agent permissioned access to transactions, balances, and account data so that agent can answer spending questions. That is a data-access building block for third-party agents, not AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside Stripe Agentic Commerce. Likewise, the 'personalized recommendations' are delivered by the host AI conversation platform rather than by Stripe itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
